overall_summary.reproducibility_verdict: All primary tables (Tables 3.5, 4.4, 4.5, 5.3, 5.5, 5.6) are 100% backed by SHA256-sealed JSON/CSV artifacts in docs/figures/data/ and results/. However, commit f550ba6 introduced 6 blocking numerical discrepancies in Chapter 5 prose/footnotes/Table 5.4 (fabricated per-parent DSRs and differences, reverse-rounded admitted counts 132,532 vs 132,524 and 130,434 vs 130,436, false episode-mean conditional completion rate 93.83% vs 92.73%, and unarchived cf=0 raw CSV in docs/figures/data/queued_joint_rl_20261106/), plus 1 selective omission in Chapter 3 Table 3.5 (omitting admitted service latency which worsened from 1.5765s to 1.6553s).

checks.claim: Canonical full-hierarchical DSR 0.2390 vs lower_no_attention 0.2507, diff -1.16 pp, 95% CI [-1.99, -0.43] pp
Bottleneck review: DSR 0.2396, uncovered 52.13% of generated (68.55% of failures); 50 snapshots: online lower 339 vs quality search 396 over 1540 generated (+3.70 pp)
5x5 Pilot: baseline DSR 0.2396 vs candidate 0.2738 (+3.43 pp, paired cross-bootstrap 95% CI [+1.20, +5.76] pp)

checks.audit_note: All 5 reported rows in Table 3.5 match confirmation_paired_comparison.json to 4 decimal places. However: (1) Metric #4 in the JSON ('Latency per admitted service request') worsened from 1.5765s to 1.6553s (+0.0789s, worsening in 37/50 paired units and 8/10 seeds) and was omitted from Table 3.5; (2) 'Penalized system latency per generated service request' (33.73s vs 28.15s) divides total UE latency across all 100 UEs (including content requests) by generated service requests only (~32.7/step), inflating the value by ~3x above the 20s penalty cap.

checks.claim: Admitted task counts reported as 132,532 for joint_rl_finetuned (with episode-mean S/A = 93.83%) and 130,434 for quality_amortized
checks.audit_note: 132,532 and 130,434 were reverse-calculated from rounded 2-decimal percentages instead of reading confirmation_summary.csv (132,524 and 130,436). Moreover, 93.83% is the conditional completion rate of quality_amortized, NOT the episode-mean S/A of joint_rl_finetuned (which is 92.73%).

checks.claim: Conditional completion rate differences for joint_rl_finetuned vs decomposed_rl_finetuned (+0.89 pp, 95% CI [+0.41, +1.46]) and vs joint_no_expectation_rl_finetuned (+0.57 pp, 95% CI [+0.02, +1.12])
checks.audit_note: Exact pooled difference vs joint_no_expectation_rl_finetuned is +0.59 pp (92.6942% - 92.1019%), not +0.57 pp; and the 95% CIs [+0.41, +1.46] and [+0.02, +1.12] are not produced by review_queued_joint_rl.py or stored in any CSV/JSON artifact.

The cf=0 numbers genuinely come from commit 97b34d7 on the same 48 confirmation episodes (252,024 generated requests), but the raw episode CSV/JSON for 97b34d7 was overwritten in-place by commit 5bd2dd7 rather than archived in docs/figures/data/queued_joint_rl_20261106/, and the net gains (+0.49, +0.74, +0.69 pp) lack paired bootstrap CIs.
